references.title: Comune di Milano — Muri liberi per street art
references.scope: 100 designated walls, map, no authorisation or fee for those walls; updated 16 June 2026. Not evidence that the mural shown is part of the programme.

references.title: Comune di Milano — Arte negli spazi pubblici a Milano
references.scope: Municipal office inventories and promotes public artworks and supports new projects.

visuals.examples: The 100 walls figure is a published municipal count, not a new count performed for this article. Creative prompts are editorial suggestions, not research results.

meaningEvidence: Original creator caption describes Milan as inspiring, expressive and artistic and links the experience to creating and exploring oneself.

Full original audio transcribed in Albanian: 0–7s every city has its own energy/personality; 7.38–15.38s Milan feels creative and expressive and inspires creation; 16.4–20.5s favourite city of the trip so far. Dialectal ASR errors were resolved conservatively by paraphrase rather than quotation.

Downloaded original poster visually inspected. It shows a wall portrait of an older woman resting her face on her hand, painted text, railings and pedestrians above in evening light. Root's actual playback review is recorded in visual-evidence.json.
limitations: The mural's exact artist, title, address, date and programme affiliation have not been established; none is invented.
Favourite city is the creator's personal response during this trip, not a comparative ranking or claim of measured creative output.

Official Milan pages returned 403 on direct fetch; the municipal pages' indexed primary-source text was retrieved in the web search on 16 October 2026, including the 16 June 2026 update date and complete Muri liberi conditions.
